verdict.rationale: The platform lets users download the fine-tuned models it produces, including 2-bit exports, and offers an open-source package for local fine-tuning, so some user-created artifacts can leave the hosted service. The evidence does not show a full data export or name the formats, so it covers only a narrow slice of the story. Missing for 10: export of all account data (generated training datasets, uploads, job history), documented open export formats, an explicit account-exit or offboarding path, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
